experiments.purpose: Run the final controlled deep-stream D3QN seed-42 architecture rescue without authorizing tuning, replication, or final-holdout evaluation.

reference.description: Existing deterministic direct-head D3QN seed-42 reference. Its maximum same-side-engine streak was 491. Benchmark A mean/solved was 225.6037 / 78%; Benchmark B mean/solved was 199.5313 / 69%.

screening_rule.description: Manual deep-stream rescue and A44 replication-eligibility review. No result or threshold schedules another run.
manual_criteria: The architecture rescue gate against direct-head D3QN requires combined mean reward at least 228.22 and solved count at least 120/150.
The rescue gate additionally requires at most 1 negative episode, at most 7 timeouts, mean length at most 285, and maximum same-side-engine streak below 100.
Relative to direct-head D3QN, each of Benchmark A and Benchmark B must improve in at least one of mean reward or solved rate.
Neither Benchmark A nor Benchmark B may materially regress; this judgment is manual because no numerical material-regression boundary was declared.
A44 balanced-leader reference: mean reward 237.929; solved 134/150 (89.33%); low 0/150; mean length 283.11; timeouts 1/150.
A44 replication eligibility requires either mean reward at least 242.929 with solved count at least 131/150, or solved count at least 142/150 with mean reward at least 235.929.

Replication eligibility additionally requires at most 1 negative episode, at most 3 timeouts, mean length at most 297.27, maximum same-side-engine streak below 100, and acceptable performance on both Benchmark A and Benchmark B.
A seed-42 result can only earn permission for a separately reviewed seed-44 replication; it cannot replace A44 directly.
All screening decisions are manual, automatic follow-up is disabled, and this plan contains no replication or additional experiment.
